verdict.rationale: Warp documents both sides of the story on one platform. Its agent handles payroll, it automates tax registrations, filings and payments across all 50 states, and it pays contractors in 150+ countries with local currency, contracts and invoicing. The evidence never explicitly names W-2 employee payroll or 1099 contractor filing, and never shows the two pay flows being run together. missing for 10: explicit W-2 employee payroll documentation, explicit 1099 contractor handling and year-end 1099 filing, evidence that employees and contractors are paid in one unified pay run or workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can pay both W-2 employees and 1099 contractors from one platform

citations.quote: Warp Agent takes onboarding, payroll, tax notices, and benefits.
Pay contractors in 150+ countries at near-Google FX rates.
Tax registrations, filings, and payments handled automatically across all 50 states.
use your company's HR, payroll, time off, workplace, and department data
